scope.method: All rg-visible *.foil files, matching axal\s*\[\s*myth\s*\]; enclosing declarations identified by + indentation. This is a complete lexical occurrence inventory, not a compiler-derived call graph. Inferred values and axal/new[myth] are not counted. Audit additionally traces selected single-record and saga transport boundaries in the companion report.
scope.snapshot_status: Pre-migration audit snapshot; locations and hashes refer to the original investigation, not current source.

crypto_probe.execution: Reaver operation 83 against the installed runtime; public known-answer vectors only. Result 1 means comparison passed, including expected verification failures.
crypto_probe.foil_ffi: No typed Foil registration for these crypto operations was found in src/reaver/foil-builtins.rvr.

committed_read.recommendation: Preserve axal[saga] in an assertion-bearing physical-read lane; keep an explicit data projection for trusted computation. Preserve current care, historical-case and transparent-prefix semantics.

mixed_read.recommendation: Uniform axal[saga] read contract for both physical and computed results. Preserve physical assertions; computed results get their own unsigned headers from the view case.

dependency.recommendation: Keep the dependency-slot map and use axal[saga] for every hydrated read, physical or computed. Unwrap only at plain-value consumer boundaries.

evaluation_evidence.recommendation: Keep computed values as myth; carry authenticated input and definition evidence alongside observations/memoized results, and validate it at the evaluator boundary.

pending.recommendation: Keep axal[myth]: this contains uncommitted or overlaid transaction values. Authenticate committed inputs before unwrapping; sign only final assertions.

proposal.recommendation: Keep axal[myth]: these are candidate publication/boot/schema inputs, before commit assigns assertion metadata.

computed.recommendation: Keep axal[myth]: synthetic metadata, transformed records or derived output cannot inherit an input assertion signature. Preserve source evidence separately when needed.

consumer.recommendation: Keep axal[myth] for local data processing/rendering after an authenticated read boundary. A provenance-aware UI or executable-definition consumer should receive checked evidence separately.

export.recommendation: Preserve individual x assertions for verifiable exports. For aggregate y/z attestation, use an explicit overlay rollup into x; do not add mandatory signed subtree or folder commitments. Presentation values can remain myth.

fixture.recommendation: Update fixtures with the selected boundary APIs; leave ordinary data/derived-value fixtures as myth. Add signing and tampering cases when implementation lands.

generated.recommendation: Keep generated pure schema/renderer signatures as myth; authentication belongs before invoking the generated consumer.

design_constraints.signing_unit: x assertion; no recursive subtree or folder signatures
design_constraints.recursion_point: At P, descendant changes do not advance P y/z versions; P own x bumps can still advance them. This preserves opacity of descendant version activity.
design_constraints.namespace_composition: Root is conceptually a recursion point. Additional recursion points permit gluing the global namespace to itself; this is the formal basis of overlays.
design_constraints.implementation_status: General recursion-point infrastructure is not implemented yet.
design_constraints.aggregate_attestation: Roll a y/z response into x through an explicit overlay and sign that x assertion.
design_constraints.ordinary_tree_response: axal[saga] carries individual live assertions without claiming aggregate completeness.
design_constraints.deletions: Tombstone evidence remains a separate representation question.

implementation.read_contract: Stored and computed committed reads use axal[saga], without a stored/computed sum type.
implementation.physical: Original aeon and content pin preserved, including historical reads.
implementation.computed: Unsigned oath, view-selected/current data case; shape/time/block remain zero because no computed shape/time ledger exists.
implementation.pending_and_computation: Pending writes, bowl.kids and computation payloads remain myth; explicit value projections unwrap assertions.
